text_block_list.text: In the school store, an Umamusume standing frozen in front of a shelf caught my attention—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Confirming obstacle parameters in the current operation.
Reassessing situation—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...The other day, Rice-san recommended an item from the school store called the "Special Selection Carrot Bread."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Told that "we'd love to hear your thoughts on the taste,"
I attempted to purchase the item to fulfill the request, but――

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The item in question was sold out.
This falls upon my inadequate prior research.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: As a countermeasure, I inquired with the clerk regarding said item and learned that it is a high-demand product bound to sell out rapidly.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I have also confirmed the timing for the next delivery batch.
The issue now is how to approach the product next time――
choice_data_list: Let's wait in line right before the store opens.
Sprint the second lunch break starts!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Make the purchase at maximum speed the moment the store opens.
Indeed, simple and rational. I shall verify this.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Cross-referencing my schedule with the delivery timing.
――Verification complete. On-site standby prior to store opening is possible.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the valuable advice.
I will ensure the operation is completed without fail.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Acknowledged. I will verify whether achieving the objective is feasible given my current specifications.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Hypothesizing day-of congestion based on intel.
Constructing route. Estimating running speed from latest metrics.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Recalculation complete.
Operation determined to be executable.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The recent speed enhancement has shown positive results.
Thank you for the valuable advice.
